title: feat(platform-objects): an "AI Assistants" tab on Setup's user page, for platform administrators
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9Hju7DThD7eoLKoJU9hnHj)_
Fixes #31085
Fixes #30894
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Setup 里用户详情页新增「AI 助手」标签页（在 API 密钥旁），内容是已合并的 `mcp:authorized-assistants` 组件：列出此人授权过的 AI 助手（如 Claude Desktop），每条可先确认再撤销。
- **为什么改**：#30894 的最后一块。服务端接口和前端组件都已就位，但没有任何页面挂出来，管理员仍找不到地方替丢了电脑或离职的人收回授权。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只加一个标签页，仅平台管理员可见（`current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true`），服务端权限不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`（新标签项与可见性条件）、`sys-user-ai-assistants-tab.test.ts`（谁能看见的判定）、`canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts`（为无 props 组件登记的豁免）。
- **两分钟验证**：用平台管理员打开 Setup → 用户 → 任一用户，应看到「AI 助手」标签并列出其授权；换普通组织管理员登录，同一页不出现该标签。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_user_detail` (the Setup user page, `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`) gains one `page:tabs` item, **AI Assistants**, placed after API Keys (both are credentials that act as this user), with the page's five inline label locales (en `AI Assistants`, zh-CN `AI 助手`, ja-JP `AI アシスタント`, es-ES `Asistentes de IA`, zh-Hant `AI 助理`, matching the Account app's existing AI-assistant spellings). Its body is `{ type: 'mcp:authorized-assistants', properties: {} }`, the widget PR #31084 registered.
- **Visibility.** The page already has an item-level gate mechanism: the Security tab carries `visibleWhen` in the `P` CEL envelope, which omits the tab header and panel when false (fail-closed on a fault). The new tab uses that same mechanism with the ADR-0095 D3 PLATFORM_ADMIN rung, `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true`, spelled exactly as the `sys_user` object's platform-admin actions spell it (`platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts`'s `STANDING`). The widget's list and Revoke go through `/api/v1/auth/admin/authorized-clients`, which refuses every caller below platform admin, so any other viewer could only see a 403. No new gating key; the server gate is unchanged (triage 6702489619: "the tab widens nothing").
- The page's header comment names the new tab.

## Tests

- New `sys-user-ai-assistants-tab.test.ts`: the whole strip in order (the tab sits after API Keys), the five-locale label (and the same locale set as every sibling tab), the body is exactly the widget with `properties: {}`, the gate is the CEL envelope with the standing, and the gate evaluated with `celEngine` under the console's binding (one subject under `current_user` / `user` / `ctx.user` / `os.user`): shown to a platform admin on someone else's record and on their own; not shown to an org owner, org admin, plain member, a tenant-written `platform_admin` position without the rung, or the signed-out identity, on either record.
- `sys-user-security-tab-own-record.test.ts`: the "which tabs carry an item gate" pin now names `['Security', 'AI Assistants']`.
- `canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts`: `mcp:authorized-assistants` has no `ComponentPropsMap` row, so door 3 of the envelope audit reported it as unmapped. The detector's header says a consumer records such an exemption in its own assert, with the reason; the exemption is held, not just stated: each exempted node must resolve at its path and author an empty `properties` bag, and a liveness test reds when the type gains a `ComponentPropsMap` row (drop the exemption) or no shipped page mounts it.

## Acceptance notes

- `mcp:authorized-assistants` has a UI-side zod arm (`@object-ui/types`) but no `ComponentPropsMap` row in `packages/spec` (its sibling `mcp:connect-agent` has `emptyProps`). The `mcp` namespace is not reserved by the enum, so the type parses on the open arm and `component-type-unknown` does not fire. Adding the spec row would retire the exemption above; it is outside this card's file surface (`packages/platform-objects/**`), so it is noted here, not done.
- A non-admin viewing their own record does not see this tab: the admin door refuses them there too. Their self-service list is Connect an Agent in the Account app.
